records.text: On August 29, 2013, the 2013 European Eventing Championship began.
records.textJa: 2013年8月29日、2013 European Eventing Championshipが始まった。

records.text: On September 1, 2013, the 2013 European Eventing Championship ended.
records.textJa: 2013年9月1日、2013 European Eventing Championshipが終わった。

records.text: On September 10, 2015, the 2015 European Eventing Championship began.
records.textJa: 2015年9月10日、2015 European Eventing Championshipが始まった。

records.text: On September 13, 2015, the 2015 European Eventing Championship ended.
records.textJa: 2015年9月13日、2015 European Eventing Championshipが終わった。

records.eventLabel: equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – individual eventing
records.text: On August 9, 2016, equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – individual eventing took place at National Equestrian Center, won by Michael Jung.
records.textJa: 2016年8月9日、equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – individual eventingが行われた（National Equestrian Center）。勝者はMichael Jung。

records.eventLabel: equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – team eventing
records.text: On August 9, 2016, equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – team eventing took place at National Equestrian Center, won by Karim Laghouag.
records.textJa: 2016年8月9日、equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – team eventingが行われた（National Equestrian Center）。勝者はKarim Laghouag。

records.text: On September 18, 2025, the 2025 European Eventing Championship began in Blenheim Palace.
records.textJa: 2025年9月18日、2025 European Eventing Championshipが始まった（Blenheim Palace）。

records.text: On September 21, 2025, the 2025 European Eventing Championship ended in Blenheim Palace.
records.textJa: 2025年9月21日、2025 European Eventing Championshipが終わった（Blenheim Palace）。
